// diagnostic

E0358

`{old}` is spelled `{canonical}`.

What

`{old}` is spelled `{canonical}`.

Why

Jet keeps acronyms fully capitalized inside PascalCase names (D-ACRO-CASE1=A, D-ACRO-LEX1=A).

Fix

Write the capitalized spelling shown by the diagnostic.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0358: tests/ui/retired_acronym_spelling.stderr.

Error [E0358]: `HttpRequest` is spelled `HTTPRequest`
  --> tests/ui/retired_acronym_spelling.jet:1:16
    |
  1 | fn handle(req: HttpRequest) {
    |                ^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: Jet keeps acronyms fully capitalized inside PascalCase names (D-ACRO-CASE1=A, D-ACRO-LEX1=A)
 Fix: write `HTTPRequest` instead of `HttpRequest`
